name: vitashop-root
description: Convenience scripts only — all real dependencies live in server/ and client/. No packages are installed at the root.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db: npm --prefix server exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.seed: npm --prefix server run seed && npm --prefix server run seed:accounts
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
